snip.cap: Grew’s telegram 4691, 5 December 1916: where the German cipher should be, “(Quote German cipher)”
snip.credit: National Archives (NARA), RG 59, 841.857/244, M580 reel 191 frame 0111, via the National Archives Catalog

system: A German diplomatic cipher telegram of unknown length; the groups were delivered to the Ambassador and not kept in the State Department file, so neither the code nor its figures are known.
